Transaction monitoring alert triage against your disposition rules

For each alert, the agent gathers the transactions, the customer profile and past alerts, applies your disposition rules, and sends anything unusual to an analyst with the context already assembled.

and any system with an API via Custom REST

What is transaction monitoring alert triage?

  • The procedure

    Your monitoring system raises an alert when activity crosses a rule or a score. Triage is the first look: an analyst gathers the transactions, the customer's expected activity and past alerts, then recommends closing the alert or escalating it. Gathering that context takes time before anyone can judge the alert.

  • What the agent does

    • Pulls the alert and recent transactions through Custom REST

    • Reads expected activity and earlier alerts from your case system

    • Screens counterparties in ComplyAdvantage

    • Applies your disposition rules and drafts the rationale or case summary

  • What your team decides

    • Confirming each closure the agent recommends

    • Escalating activity the profile does not explain

    • Whether a counterparty screening hit stands

    • Any decision to report suspicious activity, made by your MLRO or compliance officer

Setting up the Alert Triage Agent

Connect your systems

Read alerts and transactions from your monitoring system through Custom REST, screen counterparties in ComplyAdvantage, and keep the case summary in Google Drive.

  • Custom REST
  • Monitoring system · via Custom REST
  • Case system · via Custom REST

Write the rules

Your disposition rules are CEL conditions. Expected activity gets a closure recommendation; a high score or a screening hit goes to an analyst.

Sample data
alert.score > policy.review_aboveAsk an analyst
screening.hits > 0Ask an analyst
alert.pattern in profile.expectedRecommend closure

Add reviewers where the procedure says

The analyst receives the transactions, profile and history already gathered, and the disposition is logged with their reason.

Start it from the event

Each new alert from your monitoring system starts triage through a webhook. An hourly schedule picks up alerts still unassigned, and a reopened alert starts a fresh run.

  • Inbound webhook · new alert
  • Every hour · alerts still unassigned
  • Inbound webhook · alert reopened

Version and evaluate

Build scenarios from alerts your team has already worked, such as payroll activity, an unexplained pattern and a listed counterparty. A new version publishes only when they pass.

Questions about transaction monitoring alert triage

Does the agent close alerts?

No. It can recommend closure when activity matches the customer's expected profile, and an analyst confirms it. The rationale is saved to the case folder either way.

Does Verkflo raise the alerts?

No. Alerts come from your monitoring system. Verkflo reads them through Custom REST and runs your triage procedure on each one.

What does the analyst receive?

The alert, the transactions, the customer profile, earlier alerts and any screening result, gathered before the run pauses. Their disposition and reason go into the audit log.

Can unassigned alerts be picked up?

Yes. An hourly schedule picks up alerts that are still unassigned, and a webhook starts triage again when an alert is reopened.

Controls your auditors will ask about

These controls apply to each agent you build. Sample data

    Role-based access

    Admin, Author, Reviewer and Auditor roles, scoped to each workspace.

    • 417c2e…
    • 42a91f… ← 7c2e
    • 4303d8… ← a91f

    Hash-chained audit log

    Each entry carries the hash of the one before it. Verifying the log recomputes the chain and flags entries that no longer match.

  • v1.1v1.2v1.3Published

    Versioned specs

    Each run records the exact version it followed; old versions stay readable.

  • * * * * * * * *vault/sumsub/key

    Secrets in a vault

    Steps point to a vault path, and the key stays in the vault.

    • Signed delivery✓ accepted
    • Unsigned delivery✕ rejected

    Signed webhook triggers

    Unsigned or stale deliveries are rejected before a run starts.

  • SandboxLive

    Sandbox before live

    New versions run on test data first. Going live is a separate step.
